full_quality.command:
set -e
go test -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -race -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/perftrace ./internal/application/access ./internal/application/repository/retriever/postgres ./internal/application/repository ./internal/middleware ./internal/mcpserver
go test -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -race -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/application/service -run 'TestPortal|TestValidateQueryEmbeddingDimension|Test.*LiveDocument|Test.*Dynamic|Test.*Personal'
go test -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/router -run Personal
go vet -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -p 2 ./internal/perftrace ./internal/application/access ./internal/application/repository/retriever/postgres ./internal/application/repository ./internal/middleware ./internal/mcpserver ./internal/application/service ./internal/router
go build -mod=readonly -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -o /artifacts/WeKnora ./cmd/server

delta_quality.command:
set -e
go test -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -race -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/perftrace ./internal/router -run 'TestTrace|TestPersonal'
go vet -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -p 2 ./internal/perftrace ./internal/router
go build -mod=readonly -tags sqlite_fts5,anydoc -o /artifacts/WeKnora ./cmd/server
